about: Independent sport rules for the Event Stats laboratory: what each sport's scoring, restarts, discipline and wording must be, with the official source of every Ladies Football and Camogie rule. Used by the reference calculator (scripts/reference.mjs), the fixture generator, the engine and browser laboratories (capture-option probes, wording checks). Never derived from the app. Protected by the test-integrity guard.

ladies_football.name: LGFA Official Guide 2026 (Part 2 Playing Rules) as amended by the motions approved at LGFA Special Congress, 15 April 2026
ladies_football.applies: Senior adult club championship 2026 ('the new playing rules must be implemented … for all adult club championships in 2026' — Special Congress implementation proposal)
documents: LGFA Playing Rules — Motions Approved at Special Congress, 15th April 2026 (rule numbers as per the 2025 Official Guide)
LGFA New Playing Rules Enhancements Summary (17 April 2026)

camogie.name: Camogie Association Official Guide 2025 — Part 2 Playing Rules (23 May 2025) and Part 1 (1 May 2025); standard playing rules, no trial rules

football.name: Existing laboratory definition for men's Gaelic Football (GAA playing rules not supplied; matches A and B unchanged)

hurling.name: Existing laboratory definition for hurling (GAA playing rules not supplied; matches C and D unchanged)

Play.rule: Special Congress Motion 3: kicked by a player with at least one foot on or outside the 40m arc, no team-mate touch; a bounce over counts. A fisted/palmed score is not 'kicked' and is worth 1.

Free.rule: Special Congress Motions 3, 4, 5, 6 and 11: free kick or solo-and-go from on or outside the 40m arc (incl. a free taken back to the arc after an advance, a 45-foul free from the arc, a team-official misconduct free from the arc apex)

45.rule: Special Congress Motion 11 (amends Rule 368/371): a 45m kick that goes directly over, is deflected over by a defender, or bounces over with no team-mate touch counts 2

Mark.rule: Special Congress Motion 1 (kick-out mark, free from the hands at the mark) with Motion 3: 2 points when kicked from on or outside the 40m arc. Ladies has no advanced (attacking) mark — the only mark is the kick-out mark.

Penalty.rule: Official Guide 2026 Rule 426: a penalty is taken from 11 metres, inside the 40m arc — a goal (3) or a point (1), never 2

onePointFrom45.rule: Special Congress Motion 11: where a team-mate of the 45 taker plays the ball again and it goes over, one point is allowed

sidelineScoringSource.rule: No sideline two-point score in Ladies Football; a sideline kick that scores is a 1-point score from play

endLineFree.rule: Official Guide 2026 Rule 371 / Special Congress Motion 11 (45-metre kick)

discipline.noSeparateSinBin: A first Yellow Card offence is itself the sin bin (Rule 327); there is no separate sin-bin or black-card sanction.

firstYellowSinBinSeconds.rule: Official Guide 2026 Rule 327: 10 minutes Playing Time in games of one hour; 5 minutes where less than 30 minutes a half; 3 minutes where 15 minutes or less per half

secondYellow.result: red card, dismissed for the rest of the game

definitions.sinBin: sin-bin incidents: each player's first Yellow (an unattributed Yellow counts as one incident); recorded historical Sin Bin events also count
definitions.red: dismissals: distinct players with a recorded Red or a second Yellow (a second Yellow followed by an explicit Red counts once); an unattributed Red counts once

substitutions.rule: Official Guide 2026 Rule 323: 5 in adult provincial/national championships; county boards set club limits — fixture uses 5

forbidden.why: Ladies Football's end-line free is a 45 (Rule 371)

goal.rule: Part 2 Rule 15.1 ('A goal will be equal to three points')

Sideline.rule: Part 2 Rule 15.4: 'When the sliotar is played directly over the crossbar from a sideline sliotar, the score will be worth two points, provided it is not touched in flight by any player'

onePointFromSideline.rule: Part 2 Rule 15.4 (a sideline score touched in flight is not worth two) with Rule 15.2

sidelineScoringSource.rule: Part 2 Rule 11.3 'For all frees, including a side-line puck' — a sideline puck is a placed ball

markSource.rule: Camogie Official Guide 2025 has no mark

endLineFree.rule: Part 2 Rule 11.14 '45 Metre Free'; Rule 13 (a delayed puck-out gives a 45-metre free)

discipline.yellow: warning only — no time off (Part 2 Rule 10, penalty for a first offence)

secondYellow.result: second yellow followed by a red card, dismissed

sinBin.rule: No sin bin in the standard playing rules (Part 1 permits trial rules; none supplied)

definitions.red: recorded Red cards (the coach records the red shown after a second yellow)

forbidden.why: Camogie uses puck-outs and frees are struck
Camogie must not inherit football's two-point arc analysis
No sin bin in camogie's standard rules
